data.long_meaning: Derived from the Persian word 'Khushal' meaning 'joy', 'happiness', and 'prosperity'. This name was popularized in India and became a common name among Hindus. The name Khushal carries the meaning “Joy, happiness” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Persian tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Khushal usually hope their child will grow to embody joy, happiness and live with faith, good character and purpose.
